items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-03-22
items.q: We'd go to Jack Sheen up on Central Avenue. He used to give away toys to all the poor black people.

ctx.x: Trying to be better than mine.

Yeah. But, but, but anyway, uh, this, this, this Christmas, yeah, the Christmas, uh, it was such a joy. Everybody would look forward to Christmas. You know, first thing, mom and dad didn't have money to buy anything. And so we'd go to two places. We'd go to Jack Sheen up on Central Avenue. He used to give away toys to all the poor black people. Poor people, period. White and black. White would go one day and we would go the next day. And then we'd go to Harmon Park. The Harmon Park, that was on, uh, Counting and…
So you, do you, do you remember your parents ever giving you a present?
